import jobs

def test_stable_first_occurrence_wins():
    rows = [
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 2},
    ]
    res = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert [r['title'] for r in res] == ['a', 'a']

def test_no_merge_across_sources():
    rows = [
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's1', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's2', 'source_id': 1},
    ]
    res = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(res) == 2
    assert res[0]['source'] == 's1' and res[1]['source'] == 's2'

def test_empty_title_is_key():
    rows = [
        {'title': '', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'x', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
    ]
    res = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(res) == 2

def test_missing_source_id_kept_separately():
    rows = [
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': None},
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': ''},
    ]
    res = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(res) == 3

def test_input_not_mutated():
    rows = [{'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1}] * 2
    jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(rows) == 2

def test_first_occurrence_kept():
    rows = [
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
    ]
    res = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert res[0] is rows[0]
